name: EPIC 213560089

text.card: A red giant 3,186 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.99 solar masses and 8.4 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,667 K at its surface.
